release_notes:
1. Multi-Variant Parameter Engine: Explicitly exposes item_id (base product ID), variant_id (active combination ID), sku_id (exact variant article number), and item_variant (attribute label) in all ecommerce item arrays.
2. Platform Catalog Mappings: Added Back Office configurable settings for GA4, Google Merchant Center / Ads (item_id_gmc), and Meta Catalog / CAPI (item_id_meta, meta_content_ids).
3. Variant SKU Enforcement: Always outputs the selected variant reference (e.g., BHK125-R) rather than the parent reference for combination products.
